default.text: Ha! The sky-man! Rook. I'm the wall. Things hit me so they don't hit Fen.

options.text: You keep looking at the bakery.

hurt.text: Every time. That's how I know it's working. Get your guard up and face whatever's swinging: a light blow stops dead on it.

hungry.text: Always hungry. My brother weds the miller's girl this month, and I still pay for bread. Where's the justice?

options.text: Here. The next loaf's on me.
A wall that thinks about bread gets someone killed.

hungry_kind.text: Now THAT is an adventurer. Edwin! This one stays!

hungry_plain.text: That's what Osric says. Then he weighs the flour twice.

hungry_hard.text: A wall that's fainted gets everyone killed. But fine. Fine.
